title: TWI · Topographic wetness index
summary: A terrain index combining upslope contributing area and local slope to describe where water might accumulate.
body: Usually written ln(a / tan β), with specific contributing area a and slope β. Flow routing, grid resolution and treatment of nearly flat cells affect the result. TWI is not measured soil moisture or storage capacity. This app does not yet compute TWI; its relative lower-position term is a different measure.
